description: A riptide III trident: clicked every tick before and while /weather rain raises the rain level 0.01 a tick: it starts on the tick the level passes 0.2 (the click is let go, which is too brief to launch); then held 15 ticks and let go looking straight down, it launches the player (lifted 1.2 off the ground first). Then tried looking down under roofs 3 above the floor: glass (in the motion-blocking heightmap: no rain), cobweb (dampens sky light: no rain), a layer of snow (its full bottom face shuts the sky light out: no rain), white carpet (none of these: rain, a launch); on the ground of a desert (no precipitation) and of snowy plains (snow); on a pillar in a taiga at y 40 (rain, a launch) and at y 41 (the height and the temperature noise make it snow); on a pillar whose feet are in a desert and head in plains (the head's rain: a launch), and on one that only the biome jitter puts in the desert, feet and head (no launch). Started in the open and walked under the glass roof while held: let go there, no launch. /weather clear: started while the level is still above 0.2, let go once it is below: no launch.

world.note: Fabric client gametest defaults: flat world, no structures, time and weather frozen, no mob spawning

harness: Fabric client gametest: one client tick per frame, one server tick per client tick
